title: everyone signs up the same way, and the zip sets the market

criteria.text: Signup collects legal name, email, zip and display name, plus an 18+/Terms box, and verifies the email
criteria.note: [V] four fields and the 18+/Terms box on one screen (#497); production requires email confirmation (Supabase auth settings read 2026-10-18: mailer_autoconfirm false). Checked: partial: `signup-screens.test.tsx` walks every signup screen (#851) and is seen failing against an added field, a dropped box and a skipped confirmation; it leaves out "every member is verified as a person", because the phone step is switched off by PHONE_VERIFICATION_REQUIRED until the keys in #707.

criteria.text: The zip is stored and never rendered on any surface another member or visitor can reach
criteria.note: [V] members.zip readable by its owner only. Checked: yes, `tests/member-zip-private-db.test.ts` [guards F081.2] (#852): no visitor or other member reads it by row, view or callable function, and no page selects it outside signup, You and the zip change; seen failing against a view on members.zip and a page selecting it.

criteria.text: The zip decides the market, the screen names it, and nothing else decides it
criteria.note: [V] Checked: yes, `tests/signup-zip-market-db.test.tsx` [guards F081.3] (#853): signup through the real action, handler and database names the market the zip decided, the zip box starts empty, nothing to pick, and no IP, position or default on the signup path; seen failing against a default market, a pre-filled zip and a geolocation read.

criteria.text: Nobody picks a market at signup; changing the zip on /you moves the market and home town
criteria.note: [V] Checked: yes, `tests/signup-zip-market-db.test.tsx` [guards F081.4] (#854): sign up in Sacramento with nothing to pick, then three zip changes on You move the market and home town each time; seen failing against a zip that locks after signup. /you's separate 'Metro' row is #848's.

criteria.text: A line says what the app is for, and no line about not selling member information
criteria.note: [V] Checked: yes, `signup-screens.test.tsx` [guards F081.5] (#855): the line word for word on the account and profile screens, no never-sell line on any signup screen; seen failing against an added never-sell line.

criteria.text: No field, control or string in signup asks or records whether the person makes or finds
criteria.note: [V] Checked: yes, `tests/signup-zip-market-db.test.tsx` [guards F081.6] (#856): no make-or-find field, control or string on the signup screens, the handler takes no such input, a signup writes no other column; seen failing against an 'I make things' box. The make-or-find question after signup belongs to F076's waitlist entry.

criteria.text: Onboarding assigns no place the person did not give; home is the market and town the zip decided
criteria.note: [V] completeOnboardingAction writes no place (#283, #497); the home town comes from the zip (F103.5, #757). Checked: yes, src/app/onboarding/actions.test.ts ('writes no home place for anyone') carries [guards F081.7]. Reviewed: no (#283 no Reviewed by, #497 skipped)

criteria.text: Every US zip resolves to its county and market; an unknown zip is refused with the exact message; a waiting-market zip joins its waitlist
criteria.note: [V] Checked: partial: `tests/signup-zip-market-db.test.tsx` [guards F081.8 partial] (#853): every zip in the national table resolves, an unknown zip is refused in the exact words on screen, a waiting zip joins that market's waitlist with the zip kept; seen failing against reworded refusal. Leaves out the source: Census ZCTA land share stands in for HUD-USPS (#849).

criteria.text: Phone verification refuses a non-fixed VoIP number before any code is sent, with a plain message asking for a mobile number
criteria.note: [V] Checked: yes, `PhoneVerifyStep.voip.test.tsx` [guards F081.9] (#857): through the real phone screen and checkPhoneAction with Twilio Lookup mocked, a non-fixed VoIP number is refused with the plain ask and sent no code, a mobile number is looked up first then gets its code, and a Lookup outage lets the person through; seen failing against sending the code before the check. Live only once the keys in #707 exist.
